title: Authentication result as attributable evidence
description: The face authentication result sent to the user can serve as data evidence attributing the authentication attempt or outcome to the specific user, preventing the user from denying having performed the action or the result.

title: Sensitive authentication result disclosure
description: The face authentication result involves sensitive personal data (biometric authentication outcome) that may be disclosed even if only the result is sent, exceeding minimal functional needs in terms of sensitivity.

title: Identified authentication result
description: The authentication result flow contains or implies a unique reference to the identity of the data subject through the face authentication context.

title: Processing of identified face image
description: The face authentication system processes face images, which constitute identified personal data allowing direct identification of the user.

title: Highly sensitive biometric data type
description: Face images represent a sensitive biometric data type that is collected and processed, exceeding minimal functional needs in sensitivity.

title: Unawareness of face data processing
description: The user (data subject) may be unaware of the full extent of collection, processing, storage, or potential disclosure of their facial biometric data by the authentication system.

title: Unlawful processing of biometric data
description: Processing of face images (special category biometric data) without clear evidence of valid consent or other lawful basis under regulations like GDPR.

title: Sensitive biometric data type disclosure
description: Face image is a highly sensitive biometric data type being sent from the face authentication system, which may exceed strict functional necessity depending on downstream appropriateness checks.
uncertainty_note: Limited flow context; sensitivity is inherent to face images but necessity depends on exact appropriateness criteria not specified.

title: Revealing attributes enabling identification
description: The received face image contains numerous revealing attributes (e.g., facial features) that support identification of the data subject during appropriateness check and preprocessing.

title: Unnecessary analysis or transformation of face data
description: Preprocessing and appropriateness checks may involve further treatment or analysis of the face image beyond minimal functional requirements for the authentication flow.
uncertainty_note: Flow description provides no explicit details on processing depth, so this is inferred from process name.

title: Sensitive biometric data disclosure
description: Extracted facial features represent highly sensitive biometric data being sent from the face authentication system, which may exceed strict necessity if not minimized properly.

title: Biometric features as identifiers
description: The extracted features flow contains unique biometric references that allow identification of the data subject during comparison.

title: Unlawful processing of biometric data
description: Processing of extracted facial features as special category data without clear lawful basis such as explicit consent.
uncertainty_note: Biometric data requires specific legal handling but exact consent mechanism not specified in flow.

title: Sensitive biometric data disclosure
description: Preprocessed face data being sent from the authentication system is highly sensitive biometric information that could be disclosed during transfer or processing.

title: Revealing attributes in face data
description: ML-based feature extraction processes preprocessed face data which contains revealing attributes that support identification of the data subject.

title: Unnecessary enrichment of face data
description: Feature extraction may involve analysis and transformation of personal face data beyond minimal functional needs for authentication.
uncertainty_note: Based on typical ML processing but limited flow details provided.

title: Revealing attributes in captured face image
description: The captured face image includes revealing biometric attributes that support identification of the data subject.

title: Processing of identified biometric data
description: The face authentication system processes identified or identifiable face image data.

title: Sensitive biometric data type
description: Highly sensitive face image data is collected and processed by the authentication system.

title: Unawareness of face data capture
description: Data subjects may be unaware that their face image is being captured and transmitted to the authentication system.

title: Invalid consent for biometric processing
description: Processing of face images for authentication may lack valid explicit consent as required for special category data.
uncertainty_note: Depends on implementation details not specified in flow

title: Biometric template as unique identifier enables linking
description: The biometric template stored in the database serves as a unique identifier that can link the data subject's authentication events or identity across the system or with external contexts.

title: Biometric template contains unique identifier
description: The flow carries a biometric template which contains a unique reference to the identity of the data subject, making the information identifiable.

title: Highly sensitive biometric data type stored
description: Biometric templates represent a sensitive data type that requires strict necessity justification; storage in the database may exceed minimal requirements if not properly scoped.

title: Potential unlawful processing of biometric data
description: Sending biometric templates (special category data) to the database may involve unlawful processing without valid explicit consent or other appropriate legal basis under regulations like GDPR.

title: Feature vectors as quasi-identifiers
description: The feature vector flowing from the ML-based feature extraction process can combine attributes that serve as a quasi-identifier for linking to a specific individual.
assumptions: Feature vectors derived from personal data retain linkable characteristics.

title: Unnecessary transformation in ML model storage
description: Storing feature vectors in the ML Model datastore involves transformation and analysis that may exceed functional necessity for the core model.
assumptions: Feature vectors may contain derived personal data not strictly required for model storage.
uncertainty_note: Flow description is minimal, so applicability depends on specific feature contents.

title: Quasi-identifiers in stored features
description: The ML Model datastore may hold feature vectors containing combinations of attributes unique to a data subject, enabling identification.
assumptions: Features extracted could include quasi-identifying information.
